mapper.select: SELECT s.setlog_id, s.trip_id, s.trip_mission_id, s.member_id, m.nickname AS member_nickname, s.file_url, s.slot_no, s.created_at FROM setlog s INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = s.member_id WHERE s.trip_id = #{tripId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.trip_mission_id ASC, s.slot_no ASC
